from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MoneyFact(BaseModel):
    """A monetary figure found in the judgment, including type, amount, and payer."""
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical amount of the money")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit or currency, e.g., '元', '美元'")
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of fee/amount, e.g., '二审受理费', '赔偿款', '罚金'")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who pays or receives the amount, e.g., '上诉人', '被告'")
    raw_text: str = Field(description="Original text string for verification")

class CaseIdentifier(BaseModel):
    """Key identifiers extracted from a judgment document to facilitate matching."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The official case number, e.g., (2023) 湘 01 知民初 367 号")
    first_instance_court: str | None = Field(description="The court name from the first instance")
    second_instance_court: str | None = Field(description="The court name from the second instance")
    appellants: list[str] = Field(description="List of appellant names or entity names")
    appellees: list[str] = Field(description="List of appellee names or entity names")
    first_instance_fees: list[MoneyFact] = Field(description="Fee details from the first instance")
    second_instance_fees: list[MoneyFact] = Field(description="Fee details from the second instance")
    compensation_details: list[MoneyFact] = Field(description="Details on any awarded compensation or damages")
    verdict_outcome_type: str | None = Field(description="The high-level outcome, e.g., '驳回上诉', '维持原判', '准许撤回上诉'")
    verdict_summary: str | None = Field(description="A short summary of the final ruling")
    unique_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Other distinctive entities or phrases, e.g., '国家赔偿', '继承纠纷', specific company names")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document."""
    case_details: list[CaseIdentifier]
